rows.name: System Entry Flows, National, Physical
rows.description: Physical aggregated flows into the NTS calculated as the aggregate of the metered instantaneous flows at the stated time and represented as the amount of gas in mscm that would flow through the site in 24 hours at that current rate. Figures

rows.name: System Entry Flows, North, Physical
rows.description: Physical aggregated flows into the NTS for the North calculated as the aggregate of the instantaneous flows at the specified time and represented as the amount of gas in mscm that would flow through the site in 24 hours at the current rate. North zone site

rows.name: System Entry Flows, South, Physical
rows.description: Physical aggregated flows into the NTS for the South Zone calculated as the aggregate of the instantaneous flows at the specified time and represented as the amount of gas in mscm that would flow through the site in 24 hours at the current rate.  South zon

rows.name: System Entry Flows, National, Forecast
rows.description: Forecast end of day aggregate flows into the NTS based on the received delivery flow notifications (DFNs) for all entry points. Available hourly from the initial midnight forecast day ahead to a final forecast 03:00 within day.

rows.name: Demand Actual, NTS, Energy
rows.description: The amount of gas (in kWh where the NTS Average CV used to convert mscm to kWh)  delivered through the NTS for the given gas day. Actual throughput is defined as:NTS Direct loads + LDZ Offtakes + NTS Shrinkage Where:NTS direct Loads = NTS Industrial, NTS Power Stations, physical Storage Injection and physical Interconnector export. LDZ Offtakes = Sum of all individual LDZ offtakes NTS Shrinkage = Sum of NTS CV Shrinkage, OUG (Own Use Gas) and UAG (Unaccounted For Gas)

rows.name: Opening linepack (interim)
rows.description: The actual linepack at the start of the Gas Day , an estimate is generated based on the linepack PCLP1 prior to 8am, available hourly from midnight of the previous gas day through to 04:00 of the gas day.

rows.name: Predicted Closing Linepack (PCLP1)
rows.description: PCLP1 is calculated as the opening linepack (for the period up to the start of the gas day is an estimate and is the previous days  predicted closing linepack PCLP1.) plus latest supply estimate minus latest demand estimate (where supply estimate is the sum of latest DFNs received from terminal operators and Demand estimate is the sum of the OPNs received).

rows.name: Predicted Closing Linepack (PCLP2)
rows.description: PCLP1 is calculated as the opening linepack (for the period up to the start of the gas day is an estimate and is the previous days  predicted closing linepack PCLP1.) plus latest supply estimate minus latest demand estimate (where supply estimate is the sum of latest DFNs received from terminal operators and Demand estimate is the sum of the OPNs received).

rows.name: Storage Injection, Actual
rows.description: Total actually injected into storage

rows.name: Storage Withdrawal, Actual
rows.description: Total actually withdrawn from storage

rows.name: Demand Actual, NTS, D+1
rows.description:
Initial view of the amount of gas (in mscm) delivered through the NTS for the given gas day provided on the following gas day. 
Actual throughput is defined as: NTS Direct loads + LDZ Offtakes + NTS Shrinkage + Interconnector Exports, where: NTS direct Loads = NTS Industrial, 
NTS Power Stations and Storage Withdrawal and Injection.

rows.name: NTS System Input Physical, Actual (Volume), D+1
rows.description: The Volume of the gas which reflects the actual physical flow of gas onto the NTS measured at D+1.

rows.name: NTS System Input Physical, Actual (Energy), D+1
rows.description: The Energy of the gas which reflects the actual physical flow of gas onto the NTS measured at D+1.

rows.name: Opening linepack, actual
rows.description: The actual linepack at the start of the Gas Day.

rows.name: Closing Linepack, actual
rows.description: This is the opening linepack plus latest supply estimate minus latest demand estimate (where supply estimate is the sum of latest DFNs received from terminal operators and Demand estimate is the sum of the OPNs received). Published at approximately 11:30.

rows.name: NTS Volume Offtaken, LDZ Offtake Total
rows.description: The aggregate Volume of gas offtaken from the LDZ Offtakes in the preceding Gas Flow Day at the given NTS Exit Point. Provided at approximately 12:30.

rows.name: NTS Energy Offtaken, LDZ Offtake Total
rows.description: The aggregate Energy of gas offtaken from the System in the preceding Gas Flow Day at the given NTS Exit Point. Provided at approximately 11:30.

rows.name: NTS Volume Offtaken, Powerstations Total
rows.description: The aggregate Energy of gas offtaken from the System in the preceding Gas Flow Day at the given NTS Exit Point. Provided at approximately 11:30.

rows.name: NTS Energy Offtaken, Powerstations Total
rows.description: The aggregate Energy of gas offtaken from the System in the preceding Gas Flow Day at the given NTS Exit Point. Provided at approximately 11:30.

rows.name: NTS Volume Offtaken, Storage Injection Total
rows.description: The aggregate Volume of gas offtaken from the Storage Injection in the preceding Gas Flow Day at the given NTS Exit Point. Provided at approximately 12:30.

rows.name: NTS Energy Offtaken, Storage Injection Total
rows.description: The aggregate Energy of gas offtaken from the System in the preceding Gas Flow Day at the given NTS Exit Point. Provided at approximately 11:30.

rows.name: NTS Volume Offtaken, Industrial Offtake Total
rows.description: The aggregate Energy of gas offtaken from the System in the preceding Gas Flow Day at the given NTS Exit Point. Provided at approximately 11:30.

rows.name: NTS Volume Offtaken, Interconnector Exports Total
rows.description: The aggregate Energy of gas offtaken from the System in the preceding Gas Flow Day at the given NTS Exit Point. Provided at approximately 11:30.

rows.name: System Entry Volume, Aggregate Physical Volume, Storage Withdrawal, D+1
rows.description: The Volume of the gas which reflects the actual physical flow of gas onto the NTS.
